{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Remove refunded orders
refunded_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
df_final = df_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conv_rate_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute conversion rate by segment and channel
conv_rate_by_seg_channel = df_final.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack()

# Compute the difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) within each segment
diff_by_seg = conv_rate_by_seg_channel['email'] - conv_rate_by_seg_channel['paid_search']

# Print only the required values
print(f"Conversion rate (email): {conv_rate_by_channel['email']:.6f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {conv_rate_by_channel['paid_search']:.6f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (loyal, email): {conv_rate_by_seg_channel.loc['loyal', 'email']:.6f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (loyal, paid_search): {conv_rate_by_seg_channel.loc['loyal', 'paid_search']:.6f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (returning, email): {conv_rate_by_seg_channel.loc['returning', 'email']:.6f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (returning, paid_search): {conv_rate_by_seg_channel.loc['returning', 'paid_search']:.6f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search) in loyal: {diff_by_seg.loc['loyal']:.6f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search) in returning: {diff_by_seg.loc['returning']:.6f}")
print(f"Email outperforms paid_search in all segments: {diff_by_seg.gt(0).all()}")"}
